name: Lorna Petrakis

statedReqs.notes: Trustee for her late uncle's building. Has a number from 2019 and a sister who will ask why the sale came in under it.

hiddenPrefs.desc: The trust has to distribute by the end of the year, and the sister would rather have the money in the fall than the argument in the spring.

intro: Her uncle bought 330 Courthouse Row in 1987 and never once raised the barber's rent. She has his ledger, his keys and an appraisal from before the offices emptied out.

commercial.rentRoll: A barber, a tax preparer and a sandwich counter on the street; four office suites upstairs, two of them on month-to-month since the law firm left.

issues.desc: Storefront awnings torn and the sign permit lapsed in the spring
Two rooftop units past their rated life, one running on a bypassed compressor
The two month-to-month suites upstairs have both said they are going at year end
